subject.title: fix(ios): sync stale Apple localization catalog

question: Should the iOS owner accept this regenerated catalog after a current-head sync/check produces the same narrow authoritative output?
rationale: The protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling, and only an owner can decide whether the generated translations remain the desired source-of-truth output after rebasing.

options.title: Verify and land the regenerated output
options.body: Rebase the branch, attach the current-head sync/check output, and merge if the generator still changes only the intended catalog/report records.

options.title: Regenerate from current main instead
options.body: Close this branch only after an owner regenerates and lands an equivalent current-main-only catalog update through a replacement change.

recommendation.title: Verify and land the regenerated output
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, attach the current-head sync/check output, and merge if the generator still changes only the intended catalog/report records.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence ties this contributor directly to the Apple localization generator repair and its linked regression report.
